about: The world map (OpenAI image generation through Codex CLI): the region from above, without lettering; pins and routes in source/world-map.json. Original in ~/Documents/living-tabletop-world-art/.

map.prompt:
Generate one image and save it as velvet-ledger--world-map.png in the current directory.

A world map for a tabletop role-playing campaign, landscape 3:2, seen straight from above like a hand-painted illustrated map (orthographic top-down view, no perspective, no horizon, no sky). An illustrated plan of an occult-industrial city seen from above at dusk: dark brick blocks, brass heat pipes, tram rails with chains, gaslit crossings. In the centre, a large domed exchange hall with a copper bell under its cupola; nothing is drawn underground. Across the top: on the left a low printworks with sheets drying in its yard, then a solid bank with iron shutters, then a small columned civic office, and in the upper right corner a grand colonnaded ballroom seen through a cut-away roof. Above and left of the centre, a small ticket-office kiosk by a tram line; right of the centre, an archive with green lamplit windows and copper tubes on its roof. On the far left, a quiet curtained house among a few trees. Below left of the centre, a narrow lane of awninged shops hung with coils of dark red cord, ending in a tall narrow house with a brass bell over its door and a long shadow on its doorstep. A dark canal runs diagonally across the lower right; on its bank a foundry with nine smoking chimneys, and over the water a lattice of iron girders hung with heavy weights. No people, no text.

Draw every place described above as a small, clearly recognisable landmark exactly at its stated position, with the roads, paths, corridors or waterways between them visible, so that markers can later be pinned on each landmark. Fill the whole picture edge to edge with the mapped land (no border, no frame, no cartouche, no legend, no compass rose, no scale bar, no grid). Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, labels or symbols that read as letters anywhere on the map. No people, no creatures, no figures.

The attached image is this campaign's cover: match its painting technique, palette, light and mood, but not its composition.

Match one consistent house style: original premium illustrated occult-industrial noir for adult players, painterly oil and gouache with confident ink lines and crisp readable silhouettes; the city of Velten in dark brick and wet brass, steaming heat pipes, trams drawn along enchanted chains, gaslight on rain-slick cobbles; textures of crushed velvet, damp hemp cord and black ink that never quite dries; palette of soot black and charcoal, deep wine and oxblood velvet, tarnished brass gold, ink violet, pale gaslight amber and a cold dawn grey-blue; quiet tension and dry wit; every person shown is clearly an adult over 21. Tags, papers, plaques and boards carry only blank or illegible marks. No gore, no wounds, no weapons pointed at the viewer, no franchise references, no anime look, no photorealism. No text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no border.
